title: Ribbon Levels for Navbar Tabs and Window Toolbar
description: Expand the design language with ribbon levels: a ribbon strip that grows by stacked lines, one per tree level. Navbar shrinks to two toggles (left/right side panel visibility); the former panel-kind categories (workbench/display, details/settings) become the top tab row of each side panel, with plugin tabs as a row below — tabs are now a tree, arbitrarily nestable (plugin schema becomes recursive too). Window toolbar tool-group nodes expand the ribbon upward (one stacked line per pressed group, sibling press replaces rows above). Footer keeps its inline horizontal drill-down (no vertical room to grow). See plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis.md and detailed design at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis-agent-a74768b944cee9bef.md.
summary:
Renamed the window/tool "action-dispatch protocol" from Command* naming to Action* naming across ui, os, and the sketchpad ("playground") app, plus every other consumer of the shared framework-core protocol repo-wide, so no legacy "Command" naming remains for this concept. Key renames: CommandDescriptor→ActionDescriptor, CommandBus→ActionBus, CommandContext/Invocation/Result/Definition/Kind/Id→Action*, onCommand→onAction, hoverCommand/unhoverCommand/dropCommand→hoverAction/unhoverAction/dropAction, handle_command_patch_ops→handle_action_patch_ops (and every one of its ~24 plugin-crate implementations), the WIT interface's handle-command/invoke-command→handle-action/invoke-action (with regenerated Rust bindings updated), the Engagement input's "Command"→"Action" copy and identifiers in ui/js/react/index.tsx, and PlatformCommandBus/AppDefinition.commands→.actions on both the JS and Rust sides. Deliberately left untouched (a different, unrelated "command" concept per the task): the cmdk-based Command-palette UI primitives (Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, etc.), VCS/domain-command-sourcing types (DocumentVcsCommand, compose's CommandEnvelope/DomainCommand/ComposeCommand hub actor protocol, vcs CompensatingAction's sibling SemanticUndo), wgpu's CommandEncoder (GPU API), fsm's Command<M>/CommandSink state-machine effect queue, and the top-level script.ts CLI "command router" convention.

Verification: full `cargo check --workspace` passes with zero errors; framework-renderer-react test suite 74/75 pass (the one failure is a pre-existing, unrelated Bun dynamic-import quirk confirmed present before this change via git history); framework-renderer-wgpu tests 2/2 pass. A repo-wide case-insensitive grep for "command" was run multiple times to hunt down every real consumer of the renamed protocol (found and fixed follow-on breakage in framework/plugin/rs/component.rs, framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs, framework/wit/world.wit, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, infinite/world/rs/lib.rs, coda/client/ui/desktop/js/renderer.tsx, cad/renderer/js/index.tsx, and .storybook stories) beyond the files literally under ui/os/playground, since the shared protocol's public API changed and every consumer had to follow or the workspace wouldn't build.

Flagged but explicitly NOT fixed (pre-existing, unrelated to this rename): coda/client/ui/desktop/js/renderer.tsx and compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/{index.ts,boot.tsx} import from `@semio-tech/framework-platform-core` and `@semio-tech/framework-platform-renderer-react`, packages/paths that do not exist anywhere in the repo (only `framework/product/os/core` exists) — this is a broken import predating this task and out of scope for a naming rename.
